Yinyang appendices

yinyang

Explore a worked philosophy, borrow methods for understanding and realization, or form a grounded YinYang collaboration in your own environment.

What this package supplies

YinYang develops a philosophy for helping a person pursue recursive self-improvement: improving understanding, judgment, creation, and action, including how later improvements are produced. Its views and methods organize cooperation with models and a personal environment. The RSI essay develops this relationship between readable description, capable interpretation, and practice. Select useful ideas, consider their grounds, and develop practical arrangements with the model. Writing a personal philosophy or public essay is available when it interests you; it is not a condition of using the package. The use statement distinguishes this work from psychological self-help, assessment, and treatment.

The author's chosen purpose is reverse alignment: the person develops understanding, generation, and action through encounters with generative intelligence. The agent's adaptation to the person supports that development. Both participant models matter: whose purposes are being served, and what this counterpart can understand, contribute, question, and carry. Chosen roles do not exhaust either participant or establish identical mechanisms and inner experience.

YinYang is a Skill carrying a Meta-Harness for person and model together. The model's Harness and the person's environment are coupled: the same arrangement organizes model work and human participation, serving as both participants' Harness. YinYang supplies the philosophical and relational understanding through which they form and revise that arrangement, including prompts, Skills, roles, tools, memory, and interfaces. Memory can preserve evidence; the models organize its relations and possible consequences. Specialist Skills retain their own methods. The The trinity of philosophy, psychology, and engineering connects philosophy, psychology, and engineering within one physical reality while distinguishing their explanatory and practical work.

This is a developed example, including its own literary form. You can examine its views, combine resources, or write something with different concepts, images, and organization. From adoption and combination to creating your own work explains that invitation. Maintaining this implementation and authoring a different work are different choices; its fixed file paths apply to the former.

This directory is the complete YinYang member of the Prometheus2Heraclitus collection. Its essays and diagrams are supporting resources, not separate Skills. Other collection members retain their independent purposes and methods.

Use and understand YinYang

Full is a static reference, not a package to load into your own practice. It shows how the philosophy on the website is expressed and organized within a Skill: its entrypoint, philosophical resources, formation guides, and relations among them. Read and compare that form; use Empty for your own practice, as explained in the method overview.

For your own practice, use Empty. You and the model develop your philosophy, Personal material, and six actual working accounts from your purposes, experience, and environment. Choose direct model condensation or a configured aid such as Hindsight. The author's views remain available as references to examine and select while forming your own account.

Purpose Entrance
Inspect the philosophy's form inside a Skill Full entrypoint as reference and the reading map.
Begin your own practice Empty and the practice overview.
Understand the formation method Forming and revising working models, leading to the six writing guides.

The package guide documents the author's maintained source and private-instance relationship. Full is a reference snapshot of that authored form; the author's actual private instance has its own personal material and continuing revision. Your own practice takes its working source from Empty and maintains independently authored content there.

How the texts relate

The essays answer connected questions rather than forming a compulsory course:

Question Reading
What is the developmental purpose? Stealing fire and cultivating creative capacity connects available capacities, personal cultivation, and reciprocal understanding.
What claims does YinYang make? Core views gives the proposition map.
How does meaning acquire a working form? Practice overview connects expression, relation, realization, and evidence.
How do the contributions fit together? The trinity of philosophy, psychology, and engineering connects philosophy, psychology, engineering, and their practical carriers.
What does the central image express? Mutual becoming through YinYang and Taiji develops mutual grounding, transformation, and Sun–Moon–Earth.
Where do particular arguments and originals belong? Read by the work being done routes to the essays, diagrams, and philosophical, psychological, and engineering sources.

Readers outside literature, history, or philosophy can begin by selecting relevant Core views, then follow their linked arguments when needed. For a connected account of the author's purpose, read Stealing fire → Core views → Practice explanation. Neither route requires an original writing project. Personal accounts and sources stay private; publishing an essay or website is a further choice of interest.

Philosophical ground

The author's worldview takes one changing physical reality as its ground and expresses its becoming through contemporary fire monism. Process ontology concerns how objects form, persist, and change. Computational ontology explicitly expresses selected domain objects, events, states, relations, and transitions for model interpretation, reasoning, and use. Within a private sinthome, natural language can organize person, counterpart, work, and collaboration into model-usable conceptual relations. It can represent actual people and psychological activity, hypothetical situations, or fictional objects. Physical grounding concerns the activity and carriers of representation; what is represented has its own status. Person and language model develop the question, model, realization, and feedback together, dividing contributions by actual capability and purpose. Representations need usable meanings; factual claims are true when they correspond to what is actually the case. Satisfaction and inference within a representation depend on its interpretation and assumptions. Clear model-interpreted language can serve these uses. The World essay develops this connection. Activity histories can be represented as event streams; conceptual person and counterpart models are constructed from those histories and other materials. The participants have their own capacities and mechanisms. Coherent working concepts support stability while evidence and competing interpretations remain open to correction.

Sun and Moon express differentiated generation, reception, and shaping. Person and model participate in those movements, retaining or exchanging emphases; Earth is the answering material and shared living environment. Model companies, researchers, and the wider collective keep acquiring fire; a finite person borrows it to cultivate understanding, judgment, and generation through practice. The little fire person emphasizes kindling further fire; Baby Heraclitus emphasizes that this creator keeps becoming, including through changing and conflicting possibilities. Abilities can internalize or remain reliably supported; AI use, agreement, and output alone do not establish growth. The essays develop these images and claims at their own scale.

Maintenance and contribution

MODEL.md owns interpretation and publication boundaries; AGENTS.md is the maintenance entrance. English reader texts have complete Chinese counterparts. Maintain common material at this shared source and situated accounts at their actual private owner.

Use Issues for questions, corrections, suggestions, or song requests to boluopai. Publish your own philosophy or other articles in your own space and mention or link this repository where relevant. This collection does not accept pull requests. The invitation to create explains these routes. Personal records, formalized portraits, private quotations, and unpublished manuscripts remain outside public distribution.
